svg.title: AWS Inspector Remediation Agent – technical architecture
svg.text: AWS Inspector Remediation Agent — technical architecture
Which AWS services and tools take part, how they talk to each other and how each of them authenticates
AWS account · eu-north-1 · deployed with AWS CDK (AWS CloudFormation)
AWS Step Functions — cleanup workflow · one IAM role per Lambda
git push · gh pr create (OAuth token)
step in the order of the flow
aws login (browser) gives a short-lived session; every tool checks the account with AWS STS
gh CLI with an OAuth token kept in the operating system's keyring
OIDC token → AWS STS AssumeRoleWithWebIdentity → IAM role: 1 hour, ECR push only
one IAM execution role per Lambda; only DeleteImages may delete, only in demo-service
Step Functions task token in the e-mail link; only a POST from the form decides
